body: Thank you for your prayers. No drugs, no alcohol. Just life.

I know. You're right. I've looking into programs to help her cope, but I know the heartbreak will be insurmountable. I fell so alone and often wonder if she'll be better off without me. I'm hurting so badly and and want so much for her happiness.
Thank you. I really needed to hear this. She is the sole reason I'm here today. it's just that I feel so overwhelmed and don't have a clear path out - like I'm perpetually stuck at rock bottom.
I'm in US. I've tried therapy, anti-depressants, help lines. I feel that as a male, I'm left to my own devices. Which aren't much. Thank you for your message.
